definitions.meaning: Bitter of speech, given to bitter words

quotations.old_english: Þ-bar; gé ne beón tó biterwyrde, ne bealufulle on móde

source_text: biter-wyrde. Substitute: Bitter of speech, given to bitter words, and add :-- Þ-bar; gé ne beón tó biterwyrde, ne bealufulle on móde, Hml. A. 48, 576.
